name: openai-image-gen
description: Claude Code plugin: OpenAI image generation via the Responses API, with a live local gallery and an iCloud-synced image library.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.js --loader:.html=text --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
